skills.name: Process vs Thread Terminology
skills.description: Distinguishing OS processes (isolated address spaces, file descriptors) from threads (shared virtual address space, per-thread stack and registers).

skills.name: Process & Thread Memory Models
skills.description: Explaining the difference between per-thread stack allocation (automatic lifetime, stack overflow) and process-wide heap allocation (dynamic allocation, fragmentation).

skills.name: Shared Address Space Scenario Reasoning
skills.description: Analyzing concurrency implications when multiple threads read and mutate pointers in a single process shared address space.

skills.name: Race Condition Diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnosing non-atomic read-modify-write sequences on shared counters or state, identifying interleavings that cause data corruption.

skills.name: Critical Section Synchronization
skills.description: Designing and evaluating mutual exclusion, mutex locks, and condition variables to guard critical section boundaries.

skills.name: Race Condition Terminology
skills.description: Definition of race conditions, non-deterministic execution, and read-modify-write conflicts.

skills.name: Critical Section Terminology
skills.description: Definition of critical section as shared mutable code blocks needing mutual exclusion.

skills.name: Mutex and Lock Terminology
skills.description: Mutual exclusion locks, lock acquisition, release, and deadlock risks.

skills.name: Per-Process Heap & Address Space
skills.description: Explaining private virtual address spaces, per-process heap isolation, and shared heap among threads.

skills.name: Thread Stack Frame Isolation
skills.description: Explaining per-thread stack allocation, local variables, and private execution contexts.

skills.name: Thread Context Switching Overhead
skills.description: Register save/restore, cache invalidation, and scheduling quantum in thread context switches.

skills.name: Check-Then-Act Lock Scoping
skills.description: Diagnosing check-then-act race windows where lock release happens before state mutation.

skills.name: Production Intermittent Race Debugging
skills.description: Investigating intermittent overbooking or concurrency bugs occurring only under high throughput.

skills.name: Inventory Decrement Transfer Scenario
skills.description: Applying lock scoping and atomicity reasoning to e-commerce inventory balance decrements.

skills.name: Multi-Process Isolation Transfer Scenario
skills.description: Reasoning about memory copy-on-write and pointer independence across process fork boundaries.
